item.title: Impact rating for 02/05/2026
item.description: Impact on AMC last week drew 241,000 viewers, up 40,000 viewers from the prior week. The show had a 0.05 rating in 18-49, up 0.01 from the previous show. This has been the best number both in terms of viewers and demo rating since TNA moved to AMC.
